scope: Complete original supplemental real-HTTP matrix report reconstructed losslessly from checksummed public notices. Original source, verdict and cleanup are preserved; overlapping remote time earns no local checkpoint credit.

product_artifact.scope: The retained Actions ELF is distinct from the local performance ELF; current product trees must match its build source.

profile.scope: Owned backend HTTP only; foreground ledger arrivals keep their unchanged SLOs. No public TLS/DNS/SMTP/OAuth or full matrix certification.

catalog-recovery.scope: Concurrent introspection and committed DDL discovery; forced refresh failure remains covered only by its functional regression.

hostile-backend.scope: Bounded malformed JSON, nonfinite/null/deep bodies, two-second partial headers/bodies, admin cookie/origin and JWT rejection; no public-ingress or complete adversarial-matrix certification.

auth-links.scope: Real HTTP single-use verification during ledger traffic; generated private tokens are seeded directly in the owned fixture database. This does not exercise SMTP delivery, cooldown/issuance or external OAuth.

generator_cpu.scope: Ledger generator process (all threads), its current cgroup and terminated children; host CPU steal is cumulative. The sampler shares the generator cgroup. This is diagnostic evidence, not an assertion that generator saturation caused a failure.
